defect_observations.observation: The independent uniform sequence (thm:p15-independent-sequence-existence), the first and second Borel--Cantelli lemmas (thm:p15-borel-cantelli-first, thm:p15-borel-cantelli-second) and block independence are invoked by name without cross-references; the results exist earlier on the route. The same applies at lines 260-263.

'uniqueness of finite measures on a generating pi-system' is not cross-referenced; the handbook's thm:p15-measure-uniqueness is stated for probability measures, so the finite case rests on normalization or on the uniqueness part of thm:p15-premeasure-extension. Line 153 elides the nu=Z rho case as 'the identical argument' (an exact symbol swap).
The claim that the sets E_j cap D_i generate the trace sigma-field is asserted without citing thm:p15-measurability-criterion (applied to the inclusion map), the proved result that supplies it.
Positivity of each affinity under local support is asserted, relying on the statements of thm:p15-product-affinity-series and thm:p15-product-density-filtration rather than an inline check.
The range a_m in [0,1] is asserted in the definition; the upper bound follows from the square identity written only later (annex lines 290-294).
'The upper-end proof is the reversed argument' elides the mirror case of the endpoint-limit lemma.
The theorem's assertion that mu_F is finite on bounded intervals has no sentence of its own; it follows from the finite masses F(n)-F(-n) of (-n,n] written here and from monotonicity.
